_about: Performance ratings read by eye from the Mallcom 2025 catalogue for products the automatic extraction missed or misassigned. Symbol names are from the page-142 Glossary of icons. Applied by scripts/build-product-ranges.mjs over the extracted data. 'Fibreglass Toecap' for the solid-toe boot icon follows the mapping used for the other 58 footwear rows (e.g. page 99).

FREDDIE G21.note: Hero product of p108; the page's ratings row was extracted under the small FREDDIE H21 inset.

LEO B.note: Hero product of p106; ratings row was extracted under the MENNEC inset.

SCAR B.note: Hero product of p116; ratings row was extracted under the SCAR W inset.
